subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should manual `/new` and hard `/reset` require default-on confirmation across all user-facing command surfaces, and should there be any config opt-out?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible, but the fix changes established command semantics and may add a new config/default contract, both of which need maintainer product direction.

options.title: Default-on single confirmation
options.body: Require one repeated command or explicit confirm action before destructive manual resets, without adding a config knob unless a concrete opt-out need is approved.

options.title: Configurable confirmation
options.body: Add documented config for confirmation behavior and accept the extra schema, docs, tests, and upgrade-review burden.

options.title: Keep commands immediate
options.body: Leave typed `/new` and `/reset` unchanged and focus on non-destructive session creation, discoverability, or recovery elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Default-on single confirmation
recommendation.body: Require one repeated command or explicit confirm action before destructive manual resets, without adding a config knob unless a concrete opt-out need is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the closest prior implementation of New Session confirmation behavior and are the best routing candidate from the inspected history.
